description: This Java class defines services related to managing weight packages in an order shipment process within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for setting package info, updating, deleting, completing packages, and saving package data, interacting with session objects and external properties.

classes.name: WeightPackageServices
classes.description: A service class providing methods for managing weight packages in shipment processing within OFBiz.

methods.name: setPackageInfo
methods.description: Sets package information such as weight and dimensions, validating input and ensuring package quantity does not exceed ordered quantity.

methods.name: updatePackedLine
methods.description: Updates details of a specific packed line, including dimensions and shipment box type.

methods.name: deletePackedLine
methods.description: Deletes a specific packed line from the session.

methods.name: completePackage
methods.description: Completes the packaging process, setting shipment details and finalizing the package.

methods.name: completeShipment
methods.description: Finalizes the shipment, marking it as complete.

methods.name: savePackagesInfo
methods.description: Saves package information related to an order.
